Private Function Pt(p As Variant) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    s = LBound(p, 1) & "-" & UBound(p, 1) & ":"
    For i = LBound(p, 1) To UBound(p, 1): s = s & p(i, 1) & "/" & p(i, 2) & " ": Next
    Pt = s
End Function

Private Function Noded(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, a As Object, bld As Object, s As String, v As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Dim pts(1 To 3, 1 To 2) As Single: pts(1, 1) = 10: pts(1, 2) = 10: pts(2, 1) = 110: pts(2, 2) = 10: pts(3, 1) = 60: pts(3, 2) = 80: Set a = ws.Shapes.AddPolyline(pts)
    Case 1
        Set bld = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(1, 10, 10): bld.AddNodes 0, 0, 110, 10: bld.AddNodes 0, 0, 60, 80: Set a = bld.ConvertToShape
    Case 2
        Set bld = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(1, 10, 10): bld.AddNodes 0, 0, 110, 10: bld.AddNodes 0, 0, 60, 80: bld.AddNodes 0, 0, 10, 10: Set a = bld.ConvertToShape
    Case 3
        Set bld = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(1, 10, 10): bld.AddNodes 1, 1, 40, 60, 80, 60, 110, 10: Set a = bld.ConvertToShape
    Case 4
        Set a = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 5
        Set a = ws.Shapes.AddLine(10, 10, 110, 50)
    Case 6
        Set a = ws.Shapes.AddShape(5, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 7
        Set a = ws.Shapes.AddTextbox(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    End Select
    s = "ok"
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(a.Nodes)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear

    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear

    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 39
        s = s & "@@@" & Painted(i, folder)
    Next
    For i = 0 To 7
        s = s & "@@@" & Noded(i)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
